table.retrieve:
SELECT	
	ICode=Code1, AliasName=Name1, ItemName = Name2, PackingDesc=Name3,
	GroupCode = Code2, GroupName = Name4, 
	OPRate = Code3, CLRate = Code4,
	openqty	  =Code5,
	PurQty 	  =Value1,
	PurValue  =Round(Value2, 2),
	PRetQty	  =Value3,
	PRetValue =Round(Value4, 2),
	SaleQty	  =Value5,
	SaleValue =Round(Value6, 2),
	SRetQty	  =Value7,
	SRetValue =Round(Value8, 2),
	IssueQty  =Value9,
	IssueValue  =Round(Value10, 2),
	DueSatisfyQty=Value11,
	DueSatisfyValue  =Round(Value12, 2),
	ReceiptQty=Value13,
	ReceiptValue=Round(Value14, 2),
	AdjIncQty=Value15,
	AdjIncValue=Round(Value16, 2),
	AdjDecQty=Value17,
	AdjDecValue=Round(Value18, 2)
FROM
	ReportData
ORDER BY 
	GroupName, ItemName, AliasName
